payload.subject: Fast-pass CI for non-Rust changes
payload.message: The Iron CI/CD pipeline now includes a language-detection fast-pass (v4.1). When you run the /run_iron_cicd skill, it checks git diff origin/main --name-only for .rs/Cargo.toml/Cargo.lock files. If ZERO Rust-related files are found, it prints Non-Rust changes detected: Fast-passing CI and skips all cargo commands. It still writes the green commit hash to .devin/.cicd_state and agents_sync.json so the pre_commit.sh and stop.sh hooks allow your commit through. ACTION REQUIRED: Run the /run_iron_cicd skill once now. It will fast-pass since your Python script (.py) is not a Rust file. Then run your git commit again — the pre_commit hook will see the green commit hash and allow it.
